svg.title: Freeze an ID sequence, rather than paging through moving ranks
svg.desc: Ordinary inbox references and pulled author posts overlap at p3. Deduplication creates a session order p5 p4 p3 p2 p1. Page one returns p5 p4. When p6 arrives, the old continuation still returns p3 p2. Only a refresh creates a new session beginning p6 p5. Order is frozen while visibility and content authorization remain current.
svg.text: The cursor belongs to one ranked session
Merge ordinary inbox IDs and high-fanout author IDs; deduplicate before ranking.
p5, p3 · p3 is an overlap, not a second item
Session S1 · p5 → p4 → p3 → p2 → p1
Page one: p5, p4 · next candidate index = 2
Unique tie-breakers and frozen scores make the sequence unambiguous.
S1 still continues with p3, p2.
Do not insert it into S1 and shift old positions.
Repeating an item across sessions is intentional.
Frozen order does not freeze permission
Every page gates current follow, blocks, privacy and deletion before returning bodies.
